query:
The club operates with the understanding that everyone shares their Strava after every ride. Based on the conversations, does this apply to every member equally? If not, who treats this differently in practice, and what in their behaviour shows it?

Options:
A. Lena and Marcus
B. Tomás and Ben
C. Derek and Yuki
D. Saoirse and Priya
context:
[1] (about=Ben, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:40:00) haha for the record I think the café is what makes the ride worth doing. not just the ride itself. the whole thing, travel there, suffer a bit, then sit somewhere warm and eat something good.
[2] (about=Callum, core, t18 @2026-03-14T13:32:00) Full season data pack will be in Strava group by Wednesday: 10 sessions, 9 members, 783.4km total group distance.
[3] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Received GPX file; notes Strava segment for main climb is 4.7km at 6.2% average.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Derek, group-insight, t16 @2026-03-07T13:12:00) Derek said today's ride was well-paced across the board; the Saoirse-at-social-tempo experiment works.
[5] (about=Lena, episodic, t10 @2026-02-14T12:16:00) From a physio perspective that is actually an ideal model. You get the social element and the movement without the load that would compound fatigue. I am happy to run that loop with you whenever the main route does not suit. It is genuinely good periodisation.

[8] (about=Priya, core, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Wants weekly group rides; fortnightly is not enough.
[9] (about=Priya, core, t13 @2026-02-28T12:15:00) Wants to make group rides weekly; solo sessions are terrible and unmotivating.
[10] (about=Priya, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Knows a café at the bottom of the ridge that does proper oat milk lattes; that is the actual reason to ride.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Group agrees to weekly rides; no objections.
[12] (about=Saoirse, core, t8 @2026-02-07T09:21:00) Will be at most rides from now on; racing league moved to Saturday evenings.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Saoirse, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Saoirse agrees to not set race tempo on group rides.
[14] (about=Tomás, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Co-organizer of rides with Marcus.
